svg.aria-label: Venator search and rescue: an operator fences a search area, a coverage path is planned to sweep every metre inside it, the view tilts to show the aircraft flying at 40 m, it sweeps the area and reroutes in real time around a tree in its lane, detects a deer and logs it without raising an alert, finds a person who is not moving and sends an emergency with their coordinates over 915 MHz LoRa so medical help is dispatched, finds a second person who is moving and follows at 3 m, then returns home and lands with the track and every detection.
svg.title: Venator — search and rescue
svg.text: Fence an area, sweep it, find who is in it, come home.

g.text: coverage path planned to sweep every metre inside it
WP_BEGIN{n} → WP{i,lat,lon,alt} each ACKed → WP_END → 0 < alt ≤ 50 m → CONFIRM → ARMED
AUTO.TAKEOFF → 40 m · the plan is a surface, not a line
AUTO.MISSION · sweeping the area · OAK-D looking down
OAK-D depth → tree in the lane → rerouting in real time, then back on the line
detection: deer · not a person · logged with its position, no alert raised
person detected, not moving → hold station overhead
person detected, moving → OFFBOARD follow, keep 3 m
ALERT{person, x, y, static} → 915 MHz SF7 → ground station → medical dispatched to the coordinate
AUTO.RTL → home · the track and every detection land with the operator
Venator · fence an area, sweep it, find who is in it, come home.
